_comment: Subject phrases for card art generation. The generator wraps each subject in the shared style formula (see scripts/generate-card-art.mjs). Keep subjects concrete and faithful to the card's mechanics: guard = defensive stance, poisonous = venom, lifesteal = draining, stealth = concealment.
_style: Illustration ONLY, no text, no words, no letters, no numbers, no card frame, no border, no UI, no stat boxes, no signature, no watermark. Full-bleed painterly fantasy artwork filling the entire canvas. Rich oil-painting brushwork, dramatic cinematic lighting, strong readable silhouette, centered composition, dark atmospheric background.

subjects.cinder-initiate: a young ember mage apprentice channeling a swirling orange fire orb in cupped hands, ash and sparks drifting, dark stone forge hall, warm rim light
subjects.spark-runner: a lithe courier sprinting through a foundry corridor trailing a comet tail of sparks, motion blur, molten orange light streaking past
subjects.ashen-guard: a heavy armoured sentinel in soot-blackened plate braced behind a broad tower shield, embers glowing in the seams of the armour, defensive stance
subjects.flame-squire: a determined young squire raising a burning shortsword, flames licking up the blade, firelit courtyard of a forge keep
subjects.furnace-adept: a robed adept reaching into the mouth of a roaring blast furnace, molten light washing over their face, heat shimmer and floating cinders
subjects.ember-medic: a battlefield healer cradling a warm glowing ember that knits a wounded soldier's arm, gentle golden light against smoke
subjects.coalback-brute: a hulking brute with cracked coal-black hide glowing red between the plates, knuckles dragging, hunched and menacing in a smoky pit
subjects.phoenix-whelp: a small fierce phoenix chick with molten gold plumage spreading its wings for the first time, sparks scattering from the feathers
subjects.scorchblade: a masked duelist mid-lunge with twin scorching scimitars leaving searing orange arcs through the air, ash swirling

subjects.kindled-resolve: a lone warrior silhouetted against a rising wall of golden flame, fists clenched, embers spiralling upward around them
subjects.mossling: a tiny round moss-covered forest sprite with bright curious eyes peeking from between fern fronds, dappled green light
